276683371.description: This listing includes vintage Cross writing instruments featuring two pen sets in original Cross-branded boxes. The pens are 14K and 10K gold-filled as marked on the barrels, with weights of 16.9 grams for the 14K gold-filled pen and 36.7 grams for the 10K gold-filled two-pen set. Each pen has a slim design with a gold tone finish, black plastic end caps, and the Cross pocket clip. The pens are in very good condition with minimal wear and original Cross stickers on the clips. Cross is a well-known brand established in 1846, recognized for quality writing instruments.
